functions.name: redeem
functions.compact_graph:
[redeem(vault: ERC4626, shares: uint256, receiver: address, minAmountOut: uint256) -> uint256]
  EXT: (assets = vault.redeem(shares,receiver,msg.sender)) < minAmountOut  [assets <- shares, assets, receiver, vault, minAmountOut]
  N1:  assets  [<- assets]

functions.name: withdraw
functions.compact_graph:
[withdraw(vault: ERC4626, assets: uint256, receiver: address, maxSharesOut: uint256) -> uint256]
  EXT: (shares = vault.withdraw(assets,receiver,msg.sender)) > maxSharesOut  [shares <- maxSharesOut, assets, shares, receiver, vault]
  N1:  shares  [<- shares]

functions.name: mint
functions.compact_graph:
[mint(vault: ERC4626, shares: uint256, receiver: address, maxAmountIn: uint256) -> uint256]
  EXT: ERC20(vault.asset()).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),vault.previewMint(shares))  [<- shares, vault]
  EXT: (assets = vault.mint(shares,receiver)) > maxAmountIn  [assets <- maxAmountIn, shares, assets, receiver, vault]
  N1:  assets  [<- assets]

functions.name: deposit
functions.compact_graph:
[deposit(vault: ERC4626, assets: uint256, receiver: address, minSharesOut: uint256) -> uint256]
  EXT: ERC20(vault.asset()).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),assets)  [<- assets, vault]
  EXT: (shares = vault.deposit(assets,receiver)) < minSharesOut  [shares <- minSharesOut, assets, shares, receiver, vault]
  N1:  shares  [<- shares]

functions.name: eject
functions.compact_graph:
[eject(vault: ERC4626, shares: uint256, receiver: address, minAssetsOut: uint256, minExcessOut: uint256) -> uint256, uint256, bool]
  EXT: (assets,excessBal,isExcessPTs) = AutoRoller(address(vault)).eject(shares,receiver,msg.sender)  [isExcessPTs, assets, excessBal <- shares, vault, receiver]
  IF:  assets < minAssetsOut || excessBal < minExcessOut  [branch: minExcessOut, minAssetsOut, assets, excessBal]
  N1:  (assets,excessBal,isExcessPTs)  [<- isExcessPTs, assets, excessBal]

functions.name: approve
functions.compact_graph:
[approve(token: ERC20, to: address, amount: uint256)]
  EXT: token.safeApprove(to,amount)  [<- token, amount, to]
